content.short: Axiom provides Ethereum contracts with trustless on-chain data access.
content.description: Axiom is a zero-knowledge coprocessor designed to scale data-rich applications running on Ethereum. By providing access to historical Ethereum data, it lets developers request information and receive trustless, ZK-verified results settled directly on the blockchain. This capability unlocks a broad set of use cases, including trustless accounting, dynamic DeFi, off-chain governance, and on-chain oracles. All of this preserves the fundamental trust assumptions of on-chain systems, enabling more capable, verifiable data workflows.
content.meta: Axiom is a ZK coprocessor enabling trustless on-chain data access for Ethereum. Discover Axiom and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
